title: Austin Lawsuit Against Power Company
summary:
*   Austin's city leaders held a special meeting focused solely on legal matters.
*   The council entered a closed-door executive session to discuss pending litigation.
*   A key topic was the lawsuit "City of Austin vs. Houston Lighting and Power Company."
*   No other public business or policy decisions were discussed during this meeting.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - April 22, 1986 - 4 P.M
4TH FLOOR AUDITORIUM OF CENTRAL LIBRARY
Council Chambers, 307 Wfesi Second Street, Austin, Texas City Council
Frank C. Cooksey
Mayor
John Trevino, Jr.

Council Members
Mark Rose

Sally Shipman

Jorge Carrasco
City Manager
Hden Aldridge
City Clerk
Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the
absence of Mayor Pro Tern Trevino.
EXECUTIVE SESSION
Mayor Cooksey announced Council would go into Executive Session pursuant to Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to discuss matters of pending litigation,
Including but not limited to: (1) City of Austin vs. Houston Lighting and Power Company in
Travis County - Section 2, Paragraph e.
RECESS AND ADJOURNMENT
Council recessed its meeting at 4:10 for an executive session and adjourned its meeting at
6 P.M.
No other agenda items were discussed.
